home.education: UC Irvine · GDIM × Harvard Medical School · MMH
home.intro: I bring game design and interactive media into conversation with health and human experience—creating playful, thoughtful tools, stories, and worlds.

projectGroups.name: My Projects
projectGroups.intro: Health, bodies, and immersive worlds. Start here.

projects.name: Just Keep Breathing
projects.desc: My capstone project for the Media, Medicine, and Health (MMH) program at Harvard Medical School is a visual novel controlled through breathing using a Vernier Go Direct respiration belt. It tells the story of my own experiences with post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and intimate partner violence (IPV).

projects.name: Her Cycle
projects.desc: A visual novel about a girl’s menstrual cycle, unfolding across its four phases. Inspired by my own experiences with period pain, it explores the often-unspoken struggles that girls face. To watch the trailer or download and play, follow the details link.

projects.name: Exhibition of Medieval Women's Daily Life
projects.desc: A virtual exhibition about medieval women, built in Minecraft.

projects.name: Pocket Pixie
projects.desc: An AR-guided app that breaks daily tasks into small steps with emotional support, designed for users with executive function challenges such as ADHD.

projects.name: Finding James
projects.desc: Find your boyfriend in the park after a quarrel. A silly game about searching and making up. This was a homework assignment on NavMesh navigation and baking.
